title: wait inside a nested for-loop body — F-G-13d regression fence
sourceUrl: internal: STATUS.md §1 — waits inside if/case/nested-loop bodies
problemDescription: Two nested for loops; the innermost body has a wait. Session 23 F-G-13c handled waits in a single loop's Tasks. Phase 2 extends the resumable loop executor to route nested for/while dispatch through the same process-aware path so nested-body waits suspend the whole process stack.
